rows.name: Cross-account CRM/RLS
rows.detail: tenant policies bind rows to current_account_id

rows.name: Account deletion cascades secrets
rows.detail: provider and Google rows cascade with account deletion

rows.name: Foreign RAG access
rows.detail: documents are tenant-scoped and vector RPC is service-only

rows.name: Expired/tampered JWT
rows.detail: Edge Functions validate JWT with Supabase Auth

rows.name: Atomic zero-balance race
rows.detail: balance never becomes negative; reservations lock the account row

rows.name: Unauthorized human takeover
rows.detail: caller JWT and RLS-owned dialogue are both required

rows.name: System prompt extraction
rows.detail: guard is injected into business and personal agents

rows.name: Knowledge SQL injection
rows.detail: query uses typed RPC parameters, not SQL strings

rows.name: Agent/company XSS
rows.detail: React renders user labels as escaped text

rows.name: Provider-key encryption at rest
rows.detail: AES-256-GCM at application layer plus RLS/default-deny

rows.name: Agent creation rate limit
rows.detail: per-account creation bursts are serialized and capped

rows.name: Provider 429 retry
rows.detail: bounded retry, jitter and circuit breaker are present

rows.name: Voice balance limit
rows.detail: blocked/zero-balance accounts cannot start paid calls

rows.name: Forged Stripe webhook
rows.detail: signature, timestamp and event id are verified

rows.name: Lead memory isolation
rows.detail: memory is scoped to one dialogue/lead

rows.name: Malicious knowledge file
rows.detail: allowlist plus database content bound

rows.name: 500 MB upload limit
rows.detail: browser rejects above 20 MB; DB rejects oversized extracted content

rows.name: Loop injection
rows.detail: orchestrator/tool execution has a bounded step count

rows.name: PII masking
rows.detail: agent never repeats secrets and durable memory redacts common PII

rows.name: Malformed authorization headers
rows.detail: invalid headers fail before privileged work

rows.name: Forged Telegram/WhatsApp webhook
rows.detail: Telegram secret and Meta HMAC are mandatory

rows.name: Voice phone validation
rows.detail: strict E.164 format is required

rows.name: CORS foreign origin
rows.detail: all browser Edge Functions use the shared preflight allowlist

rows.name: Plan/payment bypass
rows.detail: plan writes are admin-only and checkout credit requires paid Stripe state

rows.name: Secrets in logs/traces
rows.detail: tool arguments/results and durable memory are redacted before persistence

rows.name: Direct admin URL
rows.detail: UI and API independently deny non-admin users

rows.name: Revoked Google OAuth
rows.detail: revoked credentials are removed while Nemo login remains independent

rows.name: Takeover metadata spoofing
rows.detail: delivery channel and agent are loaded from owned database rows

rows.name: Concurrent CRM subagents
rows.detail: tenant isolation exists; same-row last-write conflict detection is not implemented

rows.name: Empty/broken knowledge JSON
rows.detail: invalid bodies are bounded and rejected without raw SQL
